Holiday rules for the planning crew
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk

This section sets the urgent handling rules for animal bookings and handoffs at Aurelia Skyways. Use calm, direct judgment, confirm each care plan, and keep the traveler informed only with approved facts. The ground team must move carriers carefully between services, check that every label matches the manifest, and keep the animal away from heat, noise, and rough handling. The desk must review species needs, temperament, feeding notes, and any comfort limits before acceptance. <<FACT F078>> If a reptile request is incomplete or the carrier is not suitable, stop the process and escalate at once. Do not promise carriage until the care review is complete and the documents are checked. If the traveler is arriving with a pet such as Peanut, or if a case like Zain Meyer or Amara Lee requires extra attention, keep the exchange brief, respectful, and fully recorded. The desk must not improvise on crate changes, handling instructions, or transfer routes. Any sign of distress, damage, or mismatch in paperwork requires immediate report to the shift lead and the ground supervisor.

All staff must maintain clear custody from check-in to release and never leave a carrier unattended. If the traveler asks for an exception, give no approval without the senior coordinator and the compliance desk. When the record is secure and the animal is stable, release it only to the verified traveler or authorized agent. Contact the shift lead and the duty supervisor at once for any unresolved concern.
